chunks: So be mindful of God and listen to me.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran command believers to do in Surah Al-Shu'ara regarding God and the Prophet?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Shu'ara, this verse serves as the Prophet's mandate to deliver his message fearlessly, linking divine piety (taqwa) with practical obedience to his guidance. Shia scholarship emphasizes this dual command as a foundation for following the Ahl al-Bayt, viewing the Prophet's authority as the tangible manifestation of God's will on earth. Thus, obedience to the Prophet becomes the primary means of actualizing taqwa in daily life.
